name: Masaki Minato
source:
The only daughter of "Masaki" Inn.
Assists her mother in running the establishment.
19 years old, same age as the protagonist.

Though hardworking and eager to help others, struggles to express her feelings honestly and displays tsundere tendencies.

Special move: "Obon Rampage" – unleashes a flurry of flying serving trays
